title: Satin Nickel Shower Curtain Rod Brackets For 1-Inch Rod, Wall Mount Solid Brass (Pair) - Prestige Regal Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finish your shower curtain rod installation with sturdy, traditional brackets that keep the look clean and coordinated in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms. , these solid brass brackets are sold as a pair for a polished, built-in appearance.

  • Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives
  • Designed to fit any 1-inch diameter shower rod (rod sold separately)
  • Coordinates with matching Prestige Regal collection pieces for a unified bath

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Prestige Regal collection.

Specs

  • Product type: Shower curtain rod brackets (pair)
  • Fits: Any 1-inch diameter shower rod (shower rod sold separately)
  • Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting
  • Material: Brass (solid brass construction)
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 3 in x 2.25 in x 3 in
  • Projection: 2 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Product weight: 1.6 lb
  • Included: Shower curtain rod brackets and all installation hardware (shower rod not included)
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
